content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Hamirpur UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible. Merit list for the post of Anganwadi Helper will be prepared on the basis of minimum educational qualification of Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent, up to a maximum educational qualification of Post-Graduation The applicant must be a permanent resident of the respective Gram Sabha / Ward (Urban) . In the event that an eligible candidate of the specified category is not available in the Gram Sabha, the applicant must be a permanent resident of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 35 years Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Merit List Widow / Divorced / Abandoned women below the poverty line (BPL) of the same Gram Sabha / Ward (Urban Area) will be given priority in order. If a candidate from a BPL family who is a widow/divorced/abandoned woman is not available, women belonging to BPL families of the same Gram Sabha/Ward. Two women from the same family will not be appointed as Anganwadi Worker and Helper at the same Anganwadi Center.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Hamirpur UP Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Hamirpur UP Anganwadi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for Hamirpur UP Anganwadi Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Program Office, Hamirpur, for filling up vacant positions across various centers in the region.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 104 vacancies have been announced for the position of Anganwadi Sahayika in Hamirpur, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start date to apply for Hamirpur UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can start submitting their online application forms starting from 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Anganwadi Sahayika recruitment is 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for Anganwadi Sahayika?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a qualification of Intermediate or equivalent up to a Post Graduate degree from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 years and 35 years of age as per the guidelines specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No, the application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST categories is Nil, meaning no fee is charged.

faq.question: Q8. Through which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: All interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications exclusively through the online mode via the official web portal.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Anganwadi Sahayika posts will be based strictly on a Merit List prepared according to academic qualifications.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website to apply online?
faq.answer: You can visit the official application portal at http://upaganwadibharti.in to complete your online registration and submission process.
